configurations.name: docket-web
runtimeArgs: PREFIX=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD | sed 's#.*/##'); if [ "$PREFIX" = "main" ]; then WEB_HOST=docket.localhost; API_HOST=api.docket.localhost; else WEB_HOST=$PREFIX.docket.localhost; API_HOST=$PREFIX.api.docket.localhost; fi; export API_URL=https://$API_HOST NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://$API_HOST NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://$WEB_HOST BETTER_AUTH_URL=https://$API_HOST BETTER_AUTH_PASSKEY_RP_ID=$WEB_HOST NEXT_PUBLIC_PASSKEY_RP_ID=$WEB_HOST BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://$WEB_HOST,https://$API_HOST NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=$HOME/.portless/ca.pem; echo "[launch] web=https://$WEB_HOST api=https://$API_HOST"; pnpm exec dotenv -e .env.local -- pnpm exec turbo run dev --filter=@docket/web --filter=@docket/api

configurations.name: docket-web-localhost
runtimeArgs: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env.local -- bash -c "export WEB_PORT=4200 API_PORT=4300; export API_URL=http://localhost:4300 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4300 NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:4200 WEB_URL=http://localhost:4200 BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:4300 BETTER_AUTH_PASSKEY_RP_ID=localhost NEXT_PUBLIC_PASSKEY_RP_ID=localhost BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:4200,http://localhost:4300 BETTER_AUTH_ALLOWED_HOSTS=localhost MCP_ISSUER_URL=http://localhost:4300 MCP_RESOURCE_URL=http://localhost:4300 OIDC_LOGIN_PAGE_URL=http://localhost:4200/sign-in; unset BETTER_AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS; echo \"[launch] web=$NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL api=$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL\"; ( cd apps/api && PORT=4300 HOST=127.0.0.1 pnpm exec tsx watch src/server.ts 2>&1 | sed \"s/^/[api] /\" ) & ( cd apps/web && pnpm exec next dev --port 4200 2>&1 | sed \"s/^/[web] /\" ) & wait"
